segments.mil3.6.5:1.4: “Atthi pana, bhante, buddhassa upasampadā, udāhu natthī”ti?
segments.mil3.6.5:1.5: “Upasampanno kho, mahārāja, bhagavā bodhirukkhamūle saha sabbaññutañāṇena, natthi bhagavato upasampadā aññehi dinnā, yathā sāvakānaṃ, mahārāja, bhagavā sikkhāpadaṃ paññapeti yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyan”ti.
